result:
All 617 tests pass and typecheck is clean. Implementation complete:

- `src/config/constants.ts`: added `MAX_SUB_ISSUE_DEPTH`
- `src/lib/issue-hierarchy.ts` (new): `IssueHierarchyError`
- `src/lib/errors.ts`: wired `IssueHierarchyError` into `isDomainError`/`toAppError`
- `src/types/issue.ts`: added `IssueRollup`
- `src/types/notification.ts`, `src/schemas/notification.ts`, `src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`: added `sub_issues_completed` kind
- `src/types/event.ts`: `issue.status_changed`/`issue.archived` now carry `parentId` (and `wasOpen` for archive)
- `src/schemas/issue.ts`: added `setIssueParentSchema`/`SetIssueParentInput`
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`: added `listSubIssues`, `getIssueLevel`, `isSelfOrDescendant`, `getSubtreeHeight`, `setIssueParent`, `getIssueRollup`, `listLiveDescendants`
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`: `createIssue` now validates a given parent; `changeIssueStatus`/`archiveIssue` emit the new event fields; `archiveIssue` cascades to live descendants; added `setIssueParent`, `listSubIssues`, `getIssueRollup`
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`: fan-out for `sub_issues_completed` on status-close or archive-while-open, skipping archived/assignee-less/no-sub-issue parents
- `src/components/domain/notification/notification-preferences-form.tsx`: added the new kind's label
